content: {"question":"How does GitLab’s People Operations team ensure that employment-related information is accessible while also providing IT and People support through Compass?","answer":"The People Operations team maintains the Handbook to keep employment information accessible, and Compass routes IT, People, and business-service requests to the appropriate team with full context, so members never need to re‑explain issues.","evidence_a":"The team collaborates intensively with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure that the GitLab Handbook is consistently maintained, working to ensure that all employment‑related information is easily accessible to all whether entity‑based or through a PEO.","evidence_b":"Compass is the single place for team members to get IT, People, and business‑service help. It resolves common requests automatically and routes anything it cannot handle to the right team with full context attached, so team members never have to re‑explain an issue."}
